name: tailscale-admin
description: Administer a Tailscale tailnet through its API: comment-preserving policy file edits, auth keys, devices, subnet routes, DNS, plus a subnet-router recipe and generic access to every API operation.

TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID of the Tailscale OAuth client (Settings, Trust credentials)

TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Secret of the Tailscale OAuth client (tskey-client-...), shown once at creation

tailnet.description: Tailnet ID to administer; - means the credential's own tailnet

automationTag.description: Tag carried by the OAuth client; it must own every tag the skill mints keys for

operatorGroup.description: Policy group used as the source of access rules the recipes create

keyExpiry.description: Default expiry for new auth keys (e.g. 1h, 1d, 7d; max 90d)
